responsibility: Owns the LLVM codegen coverage context for a crate, caches per-instance profiling-name globals and MC/DC condition bitmaps, records coverage statements as codegen visits MIR, emits profiling intrinsics for counters and MC/DC updates, and hands accumulated function coverage data to final map generation.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is not a generic module root or debuginfo submodule: it owns runtime codegen state for coverage instrumentation in a crate, wiring MIR `CoverageKind` events to profiling and MC/DC LLVM intrinsics and handing collected per-function data off to coverage map generation.
